description: This file defines a static class 'StorageInstruments' that manages performance and error metrics related to storage operations within the Orleans runtime. It creates histograms and counters for read, write, and delete latency, as well as error counts, and provides methods to record these metrics.

classes.name: StorageInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing instrumentation for storage operation metrics such as latency and error counts within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnStorageRead
methods.description: Records a storage read latency metric with associated provider and state information.

methods.name: OnStorageWrite
methods.description: Records a storage write latency metric with associated provider and state information.

methods.name: OnStorageReadError
methods.description: Increments the storage read error counter with provider and state details.

methods.name: OnStorageWriteError
methods.description: Increments the storage write error counter with provider and state details.

methods.name: OnStorageDelete
methods.description: Records a storage delete (clear) latency metric with provider and state information.

methods.name: OnStorageDeleteError
methods.description: Increments the storage delete error counter with provider and state details.
